companyAnnouncements: 👋 Welcome! New to this codebase? Ask Claude Code: 'Explain the architecture of this project.'
📖 Follow our coding guidelines before committing changes.
🔍 Always run tests before pushing code.
🛡️ Never commit secrets, tokens, or credentials to the repository.
📝 Write meaningful commit messages — future you will thank you.
👀 Every PR must go through code review before merging.
⚡ Tip: Ask Claude Code to explain complex functions or trace request flows.
🧪 If you add new logic, add unit tests as well.
📦 Keep dependencies updated and remove unused libraries.
🚀 Small, focused PRs are easier to review and merge.
